title: helm(private): add postgres backup/restore initJobs and values v4 schema for upgrade/rollback safety
author: Priya Shah
description:
Background: customers running Redwood Private with an embedded PostgreSQL instance need safer upgrade/rollback semantics and a supported backup/restore path for audit logs and internal state. This PR introduces initJobs to perform pre-upgrade logical backups and optional post-rollback restores, a values schema bump (v3 -> v4) to validate backup-related configuration, templating improvements for RBAC and secrets used by backup jobs, and Helm hook semantics to prevent double-running during rolling upgrades.

What this PR does: - Adds charts/private/templates/init-backup-job.yaml and init-restore-job.yaml (hooked as pre-upgrade/post-rollback) to run pg_dump/pg_restore in controlled initJob pods. - Adds charts/private/values.schema.json v4 with new top-level `postgres.backups` block (enabled, schedule, retention, s3/k8s-secret config) and stricter validation for existing fields. - Updates charts/private/values.yaml with examples for S3 and in-cluster PVC backups. - Adds tests/integration/upgrade-rollback-test.yaml that simulates an upgrade where a backup is created and a rollback triggers a restore (mocked). - Ensures RBAC rules are scoped to the release namespace and backup service account. - Updates docs/PRIVATE_DEPLOYMENT.md with backup/restore operational steps and caveats. - Bumps Chart.yaml chartVersion and appVersion metadata.

Checklist: - [x] values schema bump and migration notes - [x] templating for initJobs + hooks - [x] RBAC and secret handling - [x] integration test harness for upgrade/rollback path - [x] docs and release notes - [x] CI green (lint + integration)

Related: Linear ENG-5123 (private upgrade safety), INF-233 (backup addon), SUP-341 (customer incident for failed rollback).
